project_title: OULAD Early Assessment At-Risk Student Prediction Dashboard

design_philosophy.tone: Calm, academic, data-dense, highly legible, precise, research-notebook aesthetic with side-by-side methodology notes and statistical confidence indicators.
anti_patterns_forbidden: NO dark generic cyberpunk gradients or full-screen neon glossy surfaces
NO Space Grotesk font (forbidden for dashboards)
NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) accent colors (forbidden for dashboards)
NO AI assistant emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮, 🎯, etc.) for UI icons or accents
NO generic centered card layouts or floating full-width dark overlays
NO raw native HTML datepickers or selects - use customized Shadcn/UI components
NO transparent backgrounds on sticky headers, dropdown menus, or tooltips

layout_and_navigation.structure: Fixed Left Navigation Sidebar + Fluid Research Scrollable Workspace with Top Status Bar
layout_and_navigation.sidebar_width: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#E2DCD2] bg-[#F4EFE8] h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-4
layout_and_navigation.top_status_bar: bg-white border-b border-[#E2DCD2] px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm sticky top-0 z-40

overview.title: Dataset & Benchmark Overview
components: Load Dataset Trigger with live status badge (Loaded / Raw / Processing)
4 Grid Summary Cards (Total Students: 32,593, Courses: 7 modules, Assessments: 206, Clicks/VLE interaction records: 10M+)
Outcome Class Distribution Stacked/Donut Chart (Pass, Distinction, Fail, Withdrawn)
Academic Context Note box explaining the early assessment prediction task window (e.g. Cut-off at Assessment 1 or Days 0-40)

explore.title: Module & VLE Engagement Explorer
components: Course Module Dropdown Selector (e.g., AAA, BBB, CCC, DDD, EEE, FFF, GGG) & Presentation (2013J, 2013B, 2014J, 2014B)
Daily VLE Clicks Over Time Line Chart with assessment deadline vertical benchmark lines
Assessment Score Distribution BoxPlot/Bar Chart grouped by outcome (Pass vs At-Risk)
Forum & Resource Interaction Heatmap/Table per module

features.title: Feature Engineering & Tradeoff Matrix
components: Tradeoffs Prose Panel: Side-by-side narrative discussing Early Cut-off Horizon vs Prediction Fidelity
Engineered Feature Categories: Demographic, Early VLE Activity, Early Assessment Performance, Forum Participation
Interactive Sample Feature Vector Table with search, sorting, and inline SMOTE balance indicators
Data-source missingness & imputation strategies badge list

experiments.title: Classifier Training & Benchmark Runner
components: Execution Panel: Run Benchmark Button (25 Trials x 10-Fold Stratified CV with SMOTE strictly in training folds)
Progress Indicator with live phase tracker (Pre-processing -> Fold Splitting -> Model Training -> Evaluation)
Model Selector & Hyperparameter Preview for Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, SVM, Naive Bayes
Quick Preview metrics mini-cards during run execution

results.title: Model Performance & Comparative Evaluation
components: Comprehensive Evaluation Table: Mean ± Std for Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC across 25 trials x 10-fold CV
Bar Charts with Error Bars (95% CI) comparing classifiers across key metrics
Multi-model ROC Curves plot with AUC confidence intervals
Confusion Matrix interactive toggle per algorithm
Feature Importance Plot (Mean Gini / XGBoost Weight / Logistic Coefficients) with scholarly interpretation prose card

phase2.title: Phase 2: Temporal Cut-Offs, Multi-Class Grade Drop & Data Ablation
components: Temporal Cut-off Timeline Chart: Precision/Recall/F1 over 5 temporal cut-offs (e.g. Day 10, Day 20, Day 30, Day 40, Day 50)
Multi-class Grade Drop Transition Matrix / Sankey / Grouped Bar Chart (Distinction -> Pass -> Fail -> Withdrawn)
Data-Source Ablation Study: Metric delta when removing VLE Clicks, Forum interactions, Demographics, or Early Assessments
Prose research synthesis on optimal intervention timing

report.title: Research Report & PDF Export
components: Executive Academic Summary document layout with key findings and methodology overview
Export PDF Button & Markdown Summary copy options
Downloadable Model Artifacts / Cleaned Feature CSV summary download
